work_statement: Build Agent() tool replacement using Celery task queue for open model spawning. Current faerie2 uses Claude CLI Agent() exclusively; open models need async task coordination layer. Create lightweight Celery bridge that: (1) emits task bundles to Redis queue, (2) spawns worker processes on Ollama/vLLM, (3) writes manifests to forensics/ just like Claude spawns do, (4) preserves investigation_label routing and compass edge semantics.

context.current_architecture: faerie2 optimized for Claude CLI Agent() tool. Manifests + compass graph are model-agnostic, but orchestration layer is Claude-specific.
context.constraint: Zero changes to manifest schema or forensic integrity. Celery bridge must emit identical manifest structure + COC entries.
context.success_criterion: Audio-ingest team can spawn llama2-70b task via Celery bridge and receive manifest with dashboard_line + compass_edge within <5s (vs. Agent() ~2s baseline).
context.scope: Celery bridge adapter only. Do NOT build reputation service (separate sys-reputation-service task) or vision adapter (separate task).

deliverables: celery_bridge.py — Task queue adapter with manifest emission
docs/celery-bridge-architecture.md — How to add Ollama workers
